name: FND_NTF_RECIPIENT
description: Table for caching the recipients preferences

columns.name: APP_MODULE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the fnd_ntf_app_module table

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: Alias or any unique identifier for the recipient

columns.name: IS_ACTIVE
columns.description: Used as pause and resume or enable or disable switch.

columns.name: PREFERENCE_JSON
columns.description: Structured (versioned) JSON object describing the recepients preference

columns.name: PREFERENCE_EXPIRY_DATE
columns.description: The expiry date & time for content in the PREFERENCE_JSON column.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
